properties.name: preset
properties.title: Colors
properties.description: Which of the panel's inks the pages use for text and highlights. A color the panel does not have is replaced by the nearest it has (black on a black-and-white panel), so the same choice works on any panel.

properties.name: background
properties.title: Page Background
properties.description: White is the usual. Black is dark mode: text and highlights trade places so every page still reads.

properties.name: textPrimary
properties.title: Main Text Ink
properties.description: The ink of the main text, headings and rules.

properties.name: textSecondary1
properties.title: First Accent Ink
properties.description: The ink of the first accent text (a month name, a label).

properties.name: textSecondary2
properties.title: Second Accent Ink
properties.description: The ink of the second accent text.

properties.name: fill
properties.title: Highlight Ink
properties.description: The ink of highlighted areas (today in the calendar, a progress bar). Where the panel has neither this ink nor red, highlights are left unfilled.

properties.name: textOnFill
properties.title: Highlight Text Ink
properties.description: The ink of the text on a highlight. When it would not read (yellow on white, the same ink as the highlight) black or white is used instead.

properties.name: fontBody
properties.title: Body Font
properties.description: The font of the text on every page (Lexend when unset). A serif such as Bitter reads best in headings, 22 px and up.

properties.name: fontHeading
properties.title: Heading Font
properties.description: The font of headings and titles. Empty: the body font.

properties.name: fontOverlay
properties.title: Overlay Font
properties.description: The font of the text shown over the pictures (the date in a corner), the same for every overlay. Empty: the heading font.

properties.name: fontScale
properties.title: Text Size
properties.description: Multiplies the size of the text on every page (1 is as designed).
